#Aletheia #Europe

Physical violence against politicians destroys democratic norms, while populist leaders leverage attacks to solidify victimhood narratives.
Plane Error: Confusing WHERE (local protest incident) with WHO (systemic ideological war). Physical assault is conflated with broader demographic struggles.

Extremist actors run a destructive physical assault, while political actors project victimhood to rally supporters against democratic rivals.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.
When political clashes turn violent, society risks descending into mutual dehumanization unless law and order prevail. (p·t + n < 0)

The Unavoidable Truth: Political violence has no place in a functioning democracy.

The Unavoidable Lie: Isolating fringe extremists erases deep-seated societal polarization.
